close_reason: Deferred: the clean fix requires changing MdnBackend::send_mdns to take HashMap<String,Mdn> (creation IDs are not JMAP IDs). Breaking API change for a P3 elegance finding — not worth it at current scale. File separately if the trait is revisited.
description: handle_mdn_send uses send_map: HashMap<Id, Mdn> but not_sent: HashMap<String, Value>. The asymmetry forces Id.as_ref().to_owned() conversions whenever an entry moves from send_map to not_sent (e.g. lines 313, 340). Use a consistent key type throughout (String or Id) to eliminate the friction. The conversion lines are subtle and easy to misread.
title: Inconsistent key types in handle_mdn_send (Id vs String in parallel maps)
